
```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', include=knitr::is_html_output()}
ch_base <- if (exists("current_chapter")) current_chapter else ""

if (nchar(ch_base) == 0 || ch_base == "_main.Rmd") {
  invisible(NULL)
} else {
  ch_lines   <- readLines(ch_base, warn = FALSE)
  title_line <- ch_lines[grep("^# ", ch_lines)[1]]

  if (length(title_line) > 0 && !is.na(title_line)) {
    ch_title <- sub("^# ", "", title_line)
    ch_title <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]", "", ch_title)
    ch_title <- gsub("\\s+", "_", trimws(ch_title))
  } else {
    ch_title <- gsub("\\.Rmd$", "", ch_base)
    ch_title <- gsub("^\\d+-", "", ch_title)
  }

  docx_name <- paste0("Quintana_GoFish_", ch_title, ".docx")
  docx_path <- paste0("/GoFish/chapter_downloads/", docx_name)

  cat(sprintf(
    '<a href="%s" download class="btn-download">⬇ Download this chapter (.docx)</a>\n\n',
    docx_path
  ))
}
```
